item.title: [Breaking] People Power's Choo Kyung-ho Wins Daegu Mayor Election... Kim Boo-kyum Humbles Himself in Concession ([속보] 국힘 추경호, 대구시장 당선…김부겸 “겸허히 승복”)
item.description:
Choo Kyung-ho, the candidate from the People Power Party, was elected mayor of Daegu in the June 3 local elections. According to the vote count from the National Election Commission (as of 2:40 a.m. on the 4th), Choo secured 52.59% of the vote, defeating Kim Boo-kyum of the Democratic Party of Korea, who received 46.37%. (추경호 국민의힘 후보가 6·3 지방선거에서 대구시장에 당선됐다. 4일 중앙선거관리위원회 개표 상황(4일 새벽 2시40분 기준)을 보면, 추 후보는 52.59%의 득표율을 얻어 46.37%를 기록한 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보에 승리를 거뒀다.)

Choo is currently on trial for charges of obstructing the National Assembly's vote to lift martial law during the December 3 emergency martial law incident last year, when he served as the floor leader of the People Power Party (charges of engaging in critical duties for insurrection). (추 후보는 지난해 12·3 비상계엄 당시 국민의힘 원내대표로 국회의 계엄 해제 표결을 방해한 혐의(내란중요임무종사) 혐의로 재판을 받고 있다.)

Early this morning, visiting his campaign office, he stated, "This is the stern order from the citizens to revive the collapsed Daegu economy and reawaken Daegu's resilience," adding, "Now Daegu must move toward unity. I will also honor the will of the citizens who chose a different candidate." (그는 이날 새벽 자신의 선거사무소를 찾아 “무너진 대구경제를 다시 살리고, 대구의 저력을 다시 깨우라는 시민 여러분의 준엄한 명령”이라며  “이제 대구는 통합의 길로 나아가야 한다. 다른 후보를 선택한 시민의 뜻도 소중히 받들겠다”고 소감을 밝혔다.)

Earlier, around 2:30 a.m., at his own campaign office, Kim said, "I humbly accept the election results. However, this is my personal defeat, not a defeat for the Daegu citizens yearning for change. I thank my comrades and supporters who stood with me, and I congratulate candidate Choo on his victory." (앞서, 김 후보는 이날 새벽 2시30분께 자신의 선거사무소에서 “선거 결과에 겸허히 승복한다. 하지만 저 개인의 패배이지 변화를 열망하는 대구 시민의 패배는 아니다. 저와 함께 해주신 동지와 지지자분들께 감사드리고, 추 후보의 당선을 축하한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Defeated Cho Kuk: "In Pyeongtaek, I Couldn't Achieve 'Zero People Power Party'... It's My Responsibility" (낙선 조국 “평택서 ‘국힘 제로’ 완수 못 했다…제 책임”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, the candidate for the Jo Kuk Innovation Party in the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election in Gyeonggi Province, said on the 4th, "The top priority in this June election was to achieve zero People Power Party (PPP), but in Pyeongtaek, I failed to fulfill that order. It's all due to my shortcomings, and it's all my responsibility." (조국 조국혁신당 경기 평택을 재선거 후보는 “이번 6월 선거의 최우선 과제는 국힘(국민의힘) 제로의 실현이었지만 평택에서는 그 명령을 완수하지 못했다”라며 “다 저의 부족함이고, 다 저의 책임”이라고 4일 말했다.)

Candidate Cho delivered his concession speech to campaign staff and supporters at his election office on Anjung-ro in Pyeongtaek around 2:47 a.m. that day. He added, "Nevertheless, we must keep flowing tirelessly together toward the sea of 'success of the people's sovereignty government.' I will always be with you to contribute to Pyeongtaek's future." (조 후보는 이날 오전 2시47분께 경기 평택 안중로에 있는 자신의 선거사무소에서 캠프 관계자들과 지지자들을 향해 낙선 인사를 했다. 조 후보는 “그럼에도 우리는 ‘국민주권정부의 성공’이라는 바다를 향해 지치지 않고 함께 흘러가야 한다”며 “평택의 미래에 보탬이 되도록 언제나 여러분과 함께하겠다”고 전했다.)

He continued, "This outcome is my failure, not a mistake in the vision and values you projected onto me. I will always walk with you to ensure those hopes are realized." (이어 “이번 결과는 저 조국의 실패이지, 여러분이 제게 투영한 비전과 가치가 틀린 것이 아니다”라며 “그 희망들이 꼭 실현되도록 언제나 여러분과 함께 걷겠다”라고 했다.)

As Candidate Cho bowed his head after the concession speech, supporters gathered at the election office applauded him and shouted, "Cheer up!" (조 후보가 낙선인사 후 고개 숙여 인사하자 선거사무소에 모인 지지자들은 그에게 박수를 보내고 ‘힘내세요’라고 외치기도 했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democrat's Choo Mi-ae Confirmed to Win Gyeonggi Governor Race... First Female Regional Head in Sight (민주 추미애, 경기지사 당선 확실…첫 여성 광역단체장 탄생 눈앞)
item.description:
Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, is effectively confirmed to win the Gyeonggi Province governor election in the June 3 local elections. If Choo secures victory, she will claim the title of 'first female head of a regional government.' Choo, who previously rose to become the most senior (six-term) female lawmaker based on her clarity of vision, is expected to solidify her position as a potential future presidential candidate within the opposition bloc. (추미애 더불어민주당 후보가 6·3 지방선거 경기도지사 선거에서 당선이 확실시된다. 추 후보가 당선을 확정 지으면 ‘최초의 여성 광역단체장’ 타이틀을 거머쥐게 된다. 선명성을 무기로 최다선(6선) 여성 국회의원 자리에 올랐던 추 후보는 향후 여권 내 차기 대선 주자로서의 입지도 다져나갈 수 있을 것으로 전망된다.)

As of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th (with 64.5% of votes counted), Choo recorded 55.2% of the vote, significantly ahead of Yang Hyang-ja of the People Power Party (39.3%) and Cho Eung-cheon of the Reform Party (4.3%). Choo was also predicted to secure over half the vote at 60.4% in the joint exit poll by three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS) released the previous day. If Choo is elected, she will become the first female regional head in 31 years since the first direct local elections in 1995. (추 후보는 4일 새벽 2시30분 현재(개표율 64.5%) 득표율 55.2%를 기록해, 양향자 국민의힘 후보(39.3%)와 조응천 개혁신당 후보(4.3%)를 크게 앞서고 있다. 추 후보는 앞서 전날 발표된 방송 3사(KBS·MBC·SBS) 공동 출구조사에서도 절반이 넘는 60.4%의 득표율을 올릴 것으로 예측됐다. 추 후보가 당선되면, 1995년 첫 민선 지방선거 이래 31년 만에 첫 여성 광역단체장으로 이름을 올리게 된다.)

Yang Hyang-ja conceded defeat on the night of the 3rd, stating, "I humbly accept the will of Gyeonggi Province residents. I offer my congratulations to Candidate Choo." At her election camp set up in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, around 12:10 a.m. on the 4th, Choo said, "I believe this election result is a victory for Gyeonggi Province residents who desire national normalization and significant change in Gyeonggi Province," adding, "I feel a heavy responsibility to ensure this becomes a choice none of us will regret. I will tackle issues such as transportation, housing, and jobs one by one." (양향자 후보는 3일 밤 “경기도민의 뜻을 겸허히 받들겠다. 추 후보께 축하를 전한다”고 패배를 인정했다. 추 후보는 4일 0시10분 경기도 수원에 마련된 선거캠프에서 “(이번 선거 결과는) 국가 정상화와 경기도의 큰 변화를 바라는 경기도민의 승리라고 생각한다”며 “결코 후회하지 않는 선택이 될 수 있도록 무거운 책임을 동시에 느낀다. 교통, 주거, 일자리 문제 등을 하나씩 풀어나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Choo maintained a strong frontrunner status throughout the election period. Although Yang, a former Samsung Electronics executive who touted herself as a 'high-tech industry expert,' attempted to mount a comeback by branding Choo a 'brawler,' she was unable to overcome Choo. The People Power Party struggled with a talent shortage during the candidate nomination process, fully exposing the limitations of its weakened party presence in the region. With this, Gyeonggi Province has handed victory to Democratic Party candidates three consecutive times, starting with current President Lee Jae-myung reclaiming the governorship from the conservative camp in 2018 after 16 years, reaffirming the province as a stronghold and new political base for the Democratic Party. (추 후보는 이번 선거 기간 내내 대세론을 유지했다. 삼성전자 임원 출신으로 ‘첨단산업 전문가’를 자처한 양 후보가 추 후보를 ‘싸움꾼’으로 규정하며 뒤집기를 시도했으나 추 후보를 꺾기엔 역부족이었다. 국민의힘은 경기지사 후보 공천 과정에서부터 구인난을 겪으며 열악한 당세의 한계를 고스란히 노출했다. 이로써 경기도는 2018년 이재명 대통령이 16년 만에 보수 진영으로부터 도지사직을 탈환한 것을 시작으로 내리 세차례 연속 민주당 후보에게 승리를 안기며, 민주당의 새로운 정치적 기반이자 강세 지역임을 재확인했다.)

Choo, a former judge, entered politics in 1995 at the urging of former President Kim Dae-jung. Starting with the 15th National Assembly, she served five terms representing Seoul's Gwangjin District alone, and after winning the Gyeonggi Hanam Gap district in the 22nd general election in 2024, she became the first female lawmaker to achieve six terms in constitutional history. Her nickname 'Chudark,' derived from her clarity and reformist stance, has become her signature brand. Notably, right up until her candidacy for Gyeonggi governor, Choo served as chair of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, garnering significant support from the party's progressive wing during discussions on the opposition's prosecutorial reform bills. During the Moon Jae-in administration, she served as Minister of Justice and clashed fiercely with former President Yoon Suk-yeol, then Prosecutor General, over prosecutorial reform. (판사 출신인 추 후보는 1995년 김대중 전 대통령의 권유로 정계에 입문했다. 15대 국회를 시작으로 서울 광진을에서만 5선을 했고, 2024년 22대 총선에서 경기 하남갑에 당선되며 헌정사상 첫 6선 여성 의원 고지에 올랐다. 선명성과 개혁성을 바탕으로 얻은 ‘추다르크’란 별명이 추 후보의 대표 브랜드다. 특히 추 후보는 경기지사 출마 직전까지 국회 법제사법위원회 위원장 자리를 지키며 여권의 검찰개혁 법안 논의 과정에서 당내 강성층으로부터 큰 지지를 얻었다. 문재인 정부 때 법무부 장관으로 재임하며 당시 검찰총장이었던 윤석열 전 대통령과 검찰개혁을 두고 격렬히 대립했다.)

As a potential dark horse for the Democratic Party's presidential nomination, if Choo wins this election, she is expected to focus on governing Gyeonggi Province while solidifying her position as a future presidential contender. The Gyeonggi governor role, overseeing the largest local government area with a population of 14 million, is seen as a springboard to the presidency. For Choo, it is also necessary to establish herself as a capable administrator to dispel her image as a hardliner, which has been viewed as a weakness. (민주당의 대권 잠룡으로 꼽히는 추 후보가 이번 선거에서 승리하면, 당장은 경기도정에 집중하면서 차기 대선 주자로서 입지를 다지는 데 주력할 것으로 보인다. 경기지사는 인구 1400만명을 관할하는 최대 광역자치단체장이란 위상 덕에 대권 교두보란 평가를 받는다. 추 후보로서도 유능한 행정가로 자리매김해 약점으로 평가받는 강성 이미지를 불식하는 것이 필요한 상황이다.)

Earlier, Choo outlined key pledges including: a major overhaul of public transit to enable commuting to major metropolitan centers within 30 minutes, supply of 550,000 public housing units centered on the third-generation new towns, and establishment of a semiconductor cluster in southern Gyeonggi and a defense cluster in northern Gyeonggi. (앞서 추 후보는 △수도권 주요 도심으로 30분 내 출퇴근이 가능한 대중교통 대전환 △3기 신도시 중심 공공주택 55만호 공급 △경기 남부 반도체 클러스터, 경기 북부 방산 클러스터 구축 등을 주요 공약으로 밝힌 바 있다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoo Ui-dong Beats Expectation, Edges Out Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk to Become Final Winner... “A Fisherman’s Prize from Division” (유의동, 초접전 끝 김용남·조국 제치고 최후 승자에…“분열에 어부지리”)
item.description:
In the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election for the National Assembly, Yoo Ui-dong, the candidate of the People Power Party, won the election. While eyes were initially on the fierce competition between Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party and Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party in the five-way race that emerged after unification bids in both progressive and conservative camps failed, the final victor turned out to be Yoo. Defeated candidate Cho suffered a political blow, and the Democratic Party also took a hit, losing what was originally its seat to the People Power Party. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 유의동 국민의힘 후보가 당선됐다. 진보·보수 진영 모두 단일화가 무산되며 5자 구도가 형성된 평택을은 애초 김용남 더불어민주당 후보와 조국 조국혁신당 후보의 치열한 경쟁에 관심이 쏠렸지만, 결국 최후 승자는 유 후보였다. 낙선한 조 후보는 정치적 치명상을 입었고, 민주당도 애초 보유했던 의석을 국민의힘에 내주며 타격을 받았다.)

As of 2:30 a.m. on the fourth (with 91.7% of votes counted), Yoo had secured 34.3% of the vote, surpassing Kim (29.1%) and Cho (27.6%), effectively confirming victory. Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party garnered 5.9%, and Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party received 3.0%. With the victory likely, Yoo stated at his campaign office, “I will take on the heavy duties given to me and walk step by step following the command given by the citizens.” (4일 새벽 2시30분 현재(개표율 91.7%) 유 후보는 34.3%를 득표해 김 후보(29.1%), 조 후보(27.6%)를 제치고 사실상 당선을 확정했다. 황교안 자유와혁신 후보는 5.9%, 김재연 진보당 후보는 3.0%를 득표했다. 유 후보는 당선이 유력해지자 선거사무소에서 “저에게 주어진 소임을 무겁게 받아들이면서 한발짝 한발짝 시민들께서 주신 명령을 따라 걸어가겠다”고 말했다.)

The joint exit poll from three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS) released right after the election on the third showed Cho (31.1%), Yoo (30.6%), and Kim (30.3%) in a tight race within a 1-percentage-point margin. However, from past midnight, as vote counts from the conservative-leaning Anjung-eup area were reflected, Yoo began to lead. It is interpreted that while the failure of unification divided progressive votes between Kim and Cho, conservative voters rallied behind Yoo instead of Hwang. (3일 선거가 끝난 직후 발표된 방송 3사(KBS·MBC·SBS) 공동 출구조사 결과는 조 후보(31.1%)와 유 후보(30.6%), 김 후보(30.3%)가 1%포인트 미만 격차로 접전 양상이었다. 하지만 이날 자정을 넘은 시각부터 보수세가 강한 안중읍의 개표 상황이 반영되면서 유 후보가 1위를 달리기 시작했다. 단일화 실패로 진보 진영의 표가 김 후보와 조 후보로 양분된 반면, 보수 유권자들은 황 후보 대신 유 후보에게 표를 몰아준 것으로 풀이된다.)

The People Power Party is buoyed by Yoo’s unexpected performance. A party official remarked, “There is an element of benefiting from the infighting of the progressive camp, but it seems that the late-stage consolidation of conservatives leaned toward Yoo, who was sincere about unification until the very end.” (국민의힘은 유 후보의 예상 밖 선전에 고무된 분위기다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “진보 진영 싸움에 어부지리인 측면도 있지만, 막판 보수 결집이 단일화에 마지막까지 진심이었던 유 후보에게 쏠린 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

Defeated candidate Cho Kuk has been dealt a significant blow. Cho and the Innovation Party poured all their party resources into this election as a make-or-break effort. However, the defeat has left Cho personally wounded and the Innovation Party’s future uncertain, having lost its central figure. After his defeat was confirmed, Cho said, “The top priority for the June election was to achieve zero seats for the People Power Party, but I failed to fulfill that command. It is all my inadequacy, and it is all my responsibility.” (낙선한 조 후보는 치명상을 입었다. 조 후보와 혁신당은 이번 선거에 모든 당력을 쏟아부으며 사활을 걸었다. 하지만 선거 패배로 개인은 물론 구심을 잃은 혁신당의 미래도 불투명하게 됐다. 조 후보는 낙선이 확정된 뒤 “6월 선거의 최우선 과제는 ‘국힘 제로’의 실현이었는데 그 명령을 완수하지 못했다. 다 저의 부족함이고 다 저의 책임이다”라고 말했다.)

After his defeat, Kim Yong-nam stated, “Rather than assigning blame, I am sorry that my shortcomings prevented me from achieving better results.” (김 후보는 낙선 뒤 “누구 잘잘못을 따지는 것보다는 제가 부족함이 많아서 더 좋은 성과를 못보여 드렸다는 것에 대해 죄송하다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party also suffered a considerable blow. Pyeongtaek-eul was a district where a by-election was held due to former lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin’s loss of office for violating election laws, yet the seat was lost to the People Power Party. Although the Democratic Party nominated Kim, the possibility of unification between Kim and Cho drew attention, but throughout the campaign, the two candidates engaged in a vicious blame game involving personal attacks, which ultimately led to a failure of unification. Amid this ongoing intense rivalry, the broader pan-opposition base became divided. Criticism is expected to arise against Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who nominated Kim, a former Saenuri Party and Reform Party member, causing this division in the pan-opposition base. (민주당도 타격이 적지 않다. 평택을은 민주당 소속 이병진 전 의원의 공직선거법 위반 의원직 상실로 재선거가 열린 지역인데도 국민의힘에 의석수를 내줬다. 민주당이 김 후보를 공천하며 선거 내내 김 후보와 조 후보의 단일화가 관심을 모았지만 선거기간 내내 두 후보 간의 인신공격에 가까운 비난전이 계속되며 끝내 단일화는 무산됐다. 계속되는 치열한 신경전 속에 범여권 지지층은 분열했다. 새누리당·개혁신당 출신인 김 후보를 공천해 범여권 지지층 분열을 야기한 정청래 대표에 대한 비판도 나올 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Wins 'Slim Victory' in Busan North Gap, Yoo Ui-dong in Pyeongtaek B… Song Young-gil Elected in Incheon Yeonsu Gap (부산 북갑 한동훈·평택을 유의동 ‘신승’…인천 연수갑 송영길 당선)
item.description:
In the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon was elected in the closely contested Busan North Gap by-election. In the Pyeongtaek B re-election, People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong emerged victorious, while Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party faced defeat. Song Young-gil of the Democratic Party of Korea secured his win in the Incheon Yeonsu Gap by-election. (6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 격전지였던 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서 한동훈 무소속 후보가 당선됐다. 경기 평택을 재선거에서는 유의동 국민의힘 후보가 승리하고 조국 조국혁신당 후보가 고배를 마셨다. 인천 연수갑 보궐선거에선 송영길 더불어민주당 후보가 당선을 확정지었다.)

As of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th, with 99.5% of the vote counted in the Busan North Gap National Assembly by-election, candidate Han Dong-hoon (43.0%) overtook Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo (41.2%), confirming his election. People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik received a vote share of 15.8%. At the same time, in the Pyeongtaek B National Assembly re-election (with 91.7% of votes counted), People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong (34.3%) led Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam (29.1%) and Innovation Party candidate Cho Kuk (27.6%), securing his win. In the Pyeongtaek B election, unification efforts failed, leading all five candidates, including Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon and Liberty and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn, to compete fully. (4일 새벽2시30분 현재 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 개표 결과(개표율 99.5%), 한동훈 후보(43.0%)가 하정우 민주당 후보(41.2%)를 앞서며 당선이 확정됐다. 박민식 국민의힘 후보 득표율은 15.8%였다. 같은 시각 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거(개표율 91.7%)는 유의동 국민의힘 후보(34.3%)가 김용남 민주당 후보(29.1%), 조국 혁신당 후보(27.6%)를 앞서며 당선을 확정지었다. 평택을 선거는 단일화가 불발돼 김재연 진보당 후보와 황교안 자유와혁신 후보까지 후보 5명이 완주했다.)

After his victory was confirmed, candidate Song Young-gil stated, “I will strive to maintain the center of the Democratic Party.” Democratic Party candidate Lee Kwang-jae, who ran in the Gyeonggi Hanam Gap by-election, and People Power Party candidate Lee Jin-sook, who ran in the Daegu Dalseong by-election, also had their elections confirmed. Democratic Party candidates from the ‘Cheong Wa Dae background’—Kim Nam-jun (Incheon Gyeyang B), Jeon Eun-soo (South Chungcheong Asan B), and Kim Nam-kook (Gyeonggi Ansan Gap)—are also seen as certain to win. (송영길 후보는 당선 확정 뒤 “민주당의 중심을 잡기 위해 노력하겠다”고 말했다. 경기 하남갑 보궐선거에 나선 이광재 민주당 후보, 대구 달성 보궐선거에 나선 이진숙 국민의힘 후보도 당선이 확정됐다. ‘청와대 출신’ 김남준(인천 계양을), 전은수(충남 아산을), 김남국(경기 안산갑) 민주당 후보들도 당선이 확실시된다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Boo-kyum, Defeated in a Close Race: "Not a Defeat for Daegu Citizens Yearning for Change" (초접전 끝 패배 김부겸 “변화 열망하는 대구시민의 패배 아니다”)
item.description:
The wall of regionalism was strong and high. Kim Boo-kyum, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate who ran in the Daegu mayoral election, tasted defeat after a tight race with People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho. (지역주의의 벽은 강고하고 높았다. 대구시장 선거에 나섰던 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보가 추경호 국민의힘 후보와의 박빙 승부 끝에 고배를 들었다.)

As of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th (with 66.1% of votes counted), Choo secured a 52.5% vote share, leading Kim (46.5%) by 6 percentage points, confirming his victory. At the same time, at his election office in Dalseo-gu, Daegu, Kim said, "I humbly accept the election results given by the citizens," and encouraged his supporters, saying, "This is my personal defeat, not a defeat for citizens who yearn for change. Do not be discouraged." (4일 새벽 2시30분 현재(개표율 66.1%) 추 후보는 득표율 52.5%로, 김 후보(46.5%)를 6%포인트 앞서며 당선을 확정지었다. 김 후보는 같은 시각 대구 달서구 선거사무소에서 “시민들께서 주신 선거 결과를 겸허히 수용한다”며 “제 개인의 패배이지 변화를 열망하는 시민의 패배가 아니다. 좌절하지 말라”고 지지자들을 독려했다.)

Kim promised to "break the wall of regionalism" and challenged the 2012 National Assembly election in Daegu's Suseong-gu district and the 2014 Daegu mayoral election, but was defeated both times. In 2016, he ran again in Daegu's Suseong-gu and became the first Democratic Party-affiliated candidate to win a National Assembly seat in Daegu, making history. He lost in the 2020 election. This local election was his "fifth challenge," coming after he retired from politics as the last prime minister of the Moon Jae-in administration, persuaded by colleagues to re-enter the fray. (김 후보는 “지역주의의 벽을 넘겠다”며 2012년 대구 수성갑 국회의원 선거와 2014년 대구시장 선거에 도전했으나 연거푸 고배를 마셨다. 2016년 대구 수성갑에 다시 출마한 그는 민주당 계열 후보로는 처음으로 대구 지역구 국회의원에 당선되는 역사를 썼다. 이후 2020년 선거에선 낙선했다. 이번 지방선거는 문재인 정부 마지막 국무총리를 끝으로 정계를 은퇴했던 그가 동료들 설득 끝에 다시 신발 끈을 매고 나선 ‘다섯 번째 도전’이었다.)

Kim was ahead in the early stages of the election, but after Choo's nomination was confirmed, the race became very close. The gap narrowed further, especially when the Democratic Party proposed a special prosecution law that effectively granted the special prosecutor the authority to dismiss indictments. Former President Park Geun-hye's campaign support for Choo near the end of the election also threatened Kim. (김 후보는 선거 초기 앞서갔으나 추 후보 공천이 확정된 뒤 선거는 초접전으로 흘렀다. 특히 민주당이 특검에 사실상 공소취소 권한을 부여한 조작기소 특검법을 발의하자 격차는 더욱 줄었다. 선거 막판 돌출한 박근혜 전 대통령의 추 후보 지원 유세도 김 후보를 위협했다.)

Amid this, Kim persistently appealed to Daegu citizens throughout the election, saying, "Daegu needs to change now." On the 2nd, Kim tearfully appealed, stating, "This is the last chance for Daegu and for me," and "If we don't judge those who have ruined Daegu's economy for 30 years, when will Daegu find its path?" He proposed working with President Lee Jae-myung to push for making Daegu an AI and robotics hub and administrative integration between Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province. (이런 가운데 김 후보는 선거 기간 내내 뚝심있게 대구시민들을 향해 “대구가 이젠 변해야 한다”고 호소했다. 김 후보는 지난 2일 “대구에도, 제게도 (이번이) 마지막 (기회)”라며 “30년 동안 대구 경제를 망쳐놓은 분들, 이번에 심판하지 않으면 대구는 언제 살길을 찾겠나”고 ‘눈물의 호소’를 했다. 이재명 대통령과 호흡을 맞춰 인공지능 로봇 수도 추진, 대구·경북 행정통합 등을 공약했다.)

However, it was not enough to shake the firmly consolidated conservative base. A Democratic Party official involved in the Yeongnam region election said, "Even with Kim's candidacy, which makes one wonder if there is a better candidate, if voters' evaluations do not change, I wonder if we can expect any change in the future." (그러나 공고히 결집한 보수층을 흔들기에는 역부족이었다. 영남권 선거를 도운 민주당 한 관계자는 “더 나은 후보가 있을까 싶은 김 후보의 출마에도 유권자 평가가 달라지지 않는다면 앞으로 변화를 기대할 수 있을지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kwon Young-guk 1.1%, Kim Jeong-cheol 0.8% Vote Share... The High Wall of Two-Party Politics Felt (권영국 1.1%·김정철 0.8% 득표…양당정치 높은 벽 실감)
item.description:
In the June 3 local elections, Kim Jeong-cheol of the Reform Party and Kwon Young-guk of the Justice Party, who challenged the Seoul mayoral race, received 0-point-something percent and 1-point-something percent of the votes, respectively, dashing their attempts to break the two-party political structure. (6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에 도전한 김정철 개혁신당 후보와 권영국 정의당 후보가 각각 0%대, 1%대를 득표하면서 양당 정치 구도를 깨겠다는 도전이 좌절됐다.)

As of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th, based on the current vote count (vote-counting rate at 49.9%), Kim Jeong-cheol of the Reform Party received 0.8%, and Kwon Young-guk of the Justice Party received 1.1%. (4일 새벽 2시30분 현재 개표 결과(개표율 49.9%), 김정철 개혁신당 후보는 0.8%, 권영국 정의당 후보는 1.1%를 얻었다.)

Candidate Kim posted on Facebook after the vote counting began, writing, "Sincere thanks to everyone who supported me." Candidate Kwon also posted on Facebook with a title, 'I will continue the dream of progressive politics toward a more equal society,' writing, "The responsibility for not being chosen by more people lies entirely with my shortcomings. Please consider it all my fault, and I earnestly ask you not to extinguish the spark of hope for progressive politics." Candidate Kwon added, "The election is over, but the dream of progressive politics toward a more equal society is not over. I will not stop dreaming of a society where one can live on labor income alone, a society with strengthened public responsibility, and a society where solidarity and equality, not discrimination and exclusion, become the norm." (김 후보는 개표가 시작된 뒤 페이스북에 글을 올려 “응원해주신 모든 분들 진심으로 감사하다”고 썼다. 권 후보도 페이스북에 ‘더 평등한 사회를 향한 진보 정치의 꿈을 이어가겠습니다’라는 제목의 글을 올려 “더 많은 분들의 선택을 받지 못한 책임은 온전히 제 부족함에 있다. 모두 저의 과오로 생각해주시고, 진보 정치를 향한 희망의 불씨는 꺼뜨리지 말아주시기를 간절히 부탁드린다”고 했다. 권 후보는 “선거는 끝났습니다만, 더 평등한 사회를 향한 진보 정치의 꿈은 끝나지 않았다. 노동소득만으로 살 수 있는 사회, 공공의 책임이 강화된 사회, 차별과 배제가 아니라 연대와 평등이 일상이 되는 사회를 향한 꿈을 멈추지 않겠다”고 적었다.)

Candidate Kim is a lawyer who represented victims in numerous financial fraud cases, including the 'Lime Asset Management incident,' which caused financial damage worth 1.6 trillion won. He gained recognition in the legal field as the 'top lecturer in criminal procedure law' and joined the Reform Party in 2024, running for election for the first time in this race. Candidate Kwon, who serves as the leader of the Justice Party, has run for election five times, including the 20th general election in 2016, the 21st general election in 2020, the 22nd general election in 2024, and the 21st presidential election last year, with this being his fifth attempt. In this election, Candidate Kwon expressed his ambition to become a voice for workers, women, sexual minorities, people with disabilities, migrants, and climate justice. (김 후보는 1조6천억원대 금융 피해가 발생한 ‘라임자산운용 사태’ 등 다수의 금융 사기 사건에서 피해자들을 대리한 변호사로, 법조계에서 ‘형사소송법 1타(1등 스타) 강사’로 이름을 알리다 2024년 개혁신당에 입당해 이번 선거에 처음 출마한 정치 신인이다. 정의당 대표를 맡고 있는 권 후보는 2016년 20대 총선, 2020년 21대 총선, 2024년 22대 총선, 지난해 21대 대선에 이어 이번이 다섯번째 선거 출마였다. 권 후보는 이번 선거에 나서며 노동자와 여성, 성소수자, 장애인, 이주민, 기후 정의의 대변인이 되겠다는 포부를 밝혀왔다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party's Park Soo-hyun Gets a Helping Hand from the 'Swing Vote' in South Chungcheong Province... Administrative Integration with Daejeon Likely to Accelerate (민주 박수현 손 들어준 ‘캐스팅보트’ 충남…대전과 행정통합 속도 낼 듯)
item.description:
In the June 3 local elections, Park Soo-hyun, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for South Chungcheong Province governor, is virtually certain to win. <<> As of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th (with 71.8% of votes counted), candidate Park secured 52.8% of the vote, leading Kim Tae-heum of the People Power Party (47.2%) by a margin of 5.6 percentage points. <<> Earlier, a joint exit poll by three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS) released at 6 p.m. on the 3rd showed candidate Park with a 52.1% vote share, ahead of candidate Kim (47.9%) by 4.2 percentage points. Shortly after the exit poll release, Park met with reporters and said, "Although it's only an exit poll result, I sincerely thank the residents and party members for confirming the hope and possibility of victory together," adding, "The people of South Chungcheong Province have chosen change. I will respond to this demand for change with a fresh perspective and bold planning." <<> South Chungcheong Province was a battleground in this local election. Historically, the province has served as a key 'swing vote' in national elections, helping gauge overall voter sentiment. Candidate Kim Tae-heum, leveraging his experience as governor, competed fiercely with Park. Since this is a region known for showing 'strategic voting' based on candidates and issues rather than party affiliation in every election, both ruling and opposition parties worked hard to secure voter support. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae visited the Chungcheong region 13 times during the official campaign period, while People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk's visits to the Chungcheong region accounted for about one-third of his official campaign schedule. <<> Candidate Park is considered one of the closest aides to leader Jeong Cheong-rae, having served as senior spokesperson early in Jeong's term. He has been recognized for his smooth communication skills, having served as the first spokesperson and senior secretary for public communication during the Moon Jae-in administration. <<> During the campaign, Park emphasized his position as the ruling party candidate, stressing, "I will bring exceptional support in all areas, including legislation, budget, and policy." He pledged to design his pledges based on the difficulties heard on the ground, recording suggestions from residents in his notebook. From the primary stage onward, he held over 130 field meetings and policy agreements, demonstrating his commitment to focusing on policy. If Park is elected, the administrative integration of South Chungcheong and Daejeon is expected to accelerate. Previously, Park proposed to the party leadership: (1) expedited confirmation of the South Chungcheong-Daejeon Administrative Integration Special Act as party policy and its legislative enactment, and (2) attraction of a second round of public institutions to South Chungcheong Province. <<> Reporter Go Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거에서 박수현 더불어민주당 충남지사 후보 당선이 확실시된다.)

item.title: Democratic's Woo Sang-ho Wins Gangwon Governor Race, Defeating Incumbent Kim Jin-tae (민주 우상호, 강원지사 당선…현역 김진태 꺾어)
item.description:
Woo Sang-ho, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, has been elected as the governor of Gangwon Province in the 6·3 local elections. According to the vote tally by the National Election Commission as of 4 a.m. on the 4th, Woo won 51.43% of the vote, defeating Kim Jin-tae of the People Power Party, who garnered 48.56%. Woo, a native of Cheorwon, Gangwon Province, has served as a four-term lawmaker and as the first senior presidential secretary for political affairs in the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. (우 후보는 강원 철원 출신으로, 4선 국회의원과 이재명 정부 첫 청와대 정무수석을 지냈다.)

item.title: NEC: "Vote counting cannot be halted... Insufficient ballot papers not grounds for re-election" (선관위 “개표 중단 불가…투표용지 부족, 재선거 사유 아냐”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) stated on the 4th regarding the ballot paper shortage that occurred on the 3rd, the main voting day for the June 3 local elections, that "this does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or holding a re-election." (중앙선거관리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 벌어진 투표용지 부족사태와 관련해 “선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”고 4일 밝혔다.)

In a statement released around 3:53 a.m. that day, the NEC said, "This incident, caused by a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations on election day, does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or holding a re-election under the Public Official Election Act." (선관위는 이날 오전3시53분께 입장문을 내어 “선거일 일부 투표소의 투표용지 부족으로 발생한 이번 사안은 공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”고 밝혔다.)

The NEC further stated, "It is impossible to halt the ongoing vote counting, and the ballot boxes should be transported to the counting center to ensure that the intentions of voters who cast ballots at the affected polling stations can be verified." (이어 선관위는 “현재 진행되는 개표를 중단하는 것은 불가하며, 해당 투표소에 투표한 유권자의 의사를 확인할 수 있도록 투표함은 개표소로 이송돼야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

The NEC added, "Once the vote counting is complete, we have decided to make every possible effort to immediately investigate the truth of this incident and establish measures to prevent recurrence." (선관위는 또한 “개표가 종료되면 즉시 이번 사안에 대한 진상 규명 및 재발방지 대책을 마련하기 위해 가능한 최선의 노력을 다하기로 결정했다”고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the main voting day of the June 3 local elections, at least 14 polling stations experienced a temporary suspension of voting due to ballot paper shortages, leading to an unprecedented situation where some voters gave up and left, while voting was extended late into the night in other cases. (앞서 6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 투표소 최소 14곳에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 일시 중단되면서 일부 유권자가 투표를 포기한 채 발길을 돌리거나 밤늦게까지 투표가 연장되는 전례 없는 사태가 발생했다.)

Below is the full text of the NEC's statement. (다음은 선관위 입장문 전문이다.)

Statement from the National Election Commission on the Ballot Paper Shortage Incident on Election Day for the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections (제9회 전국동시지방선거 선거일 투표용지 부족 사태에 대한 중앙선거관리위원회 입장)

We deeply apologize for the significant confusion and inconvenience caused to the public who visited polling stations on June 3, due to a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations, hindering the exercise of their voting rights. ( 지난 6월 3일 일부 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족하여 해당 투표소에 방문한 국민 여러분의 참정권 행사에 많은 혼란과 불편을 드려 깊이 사과드립니다.)

We keenly feel our great responsibility for the disappointment and concern caused to voters who gave up their valuable time to visit polling stations to exercise their right to vote and participate in democracy, only to be affected by the Election Commission's failure. ( 한 분 한 분의 유권자께서 소중한 시간을 내어 투표소를 찾아주셨음에도 선거관리위원회의 실책으로 인해 투표권을 행사하여 민주주의에 참여하고자 투표소를 방문하신 유권자에게 큰 실망과 염려를 끼쳐 드리게 되어 크나큰 책임을 통감합니다.)

However, this incident, arising from a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations on election day, does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or holding a re-election under the Public Official Election Act. Therefore, it is impossible to halt the ongoing vote counting, and the ballot boxes from the affected polling stations should be transported to the counting center to verify the intentions of voters who cast their ballots there. ( 다만, 선거일 일부 투표소의 투표용지 부족으로 발생한 이번 사안은 「공직선거법」에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않습니다. 따라서 현재 진행되는 개표를 중단하는 것은 불가하며, 해당 투표소에서 투표한 유권자의 의사를 확인할 수 있도록 투표함은 개표소로 이송되어야 할 것입니다.)

Once the vote counting is complete, the National Election Commission has decided to make every possible effort to immediately investigate the truth of this incident and establish measures to prevent recurrence. ( 개표가 종료되면 중앙선거관리위원회는 즉시 이번 사안에 대한 진상 규명 및 재발방지 대책을 마련하기 위해 가능한 최선의 노력을 다 하기로 결정했습니다. )

We once again apologize for failing to ensure the smooth exercise of the people's voting rights, and we promise to thoroughly disclose the causes and measures to the public and ensure that such an incident never occurs again. ( 국민의 참정권 행사가 원활하게 이루어지도록 만전을 기하지 못한 점에 대해 다시 한 번 사죄를 드리며, 이후 국민 여러분께 원인과 대책을 소상히 밝히고 다시는 이런 일이 발생하지 않도록 할 것임을 약속드립니다.)

June 4, 2026.
National Election Commission (2026.  6.  4.
중앙선거관리위원회 )

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Public sentiment empowers 'Lee Jae-myung administration'... Ruling party wins local elections (민심, ‘이재명 정부’에 힘 실어줬다…여당, 지방선거 승리)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea won the June 3 local elections held one year after the inauguration of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The Democratic Party is expected to win in up to 13 regions, including the Busan and Ulsan mayoral elections. The People Power Party secured victories in at least 2 regions, such as the Daegu mayoral and North Gyeongsang Province gubernatorial elections. As public sentiment favored the Democratic Party's 'support for the Lee Jae-myung administration and judgment against the insurrection party' over the People Power Party's 'check on the regime and judgment theory', the Democratic Party achieved a third consecutive victory following the 2024 general election and the 2025 presidential election, gaining not only legislative and executive power but also local power. (이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치른 6·3 지방선거에서 더불어민주당이 승리했다. 민주당은 부산·울산시장 선거 등 최대 13곳에서 승리할 것으로 보인다. 국민의힘은 대구시장과 경북지사 등 최소 2곳에서 승리했다. 민심이 국민의힘의 ‘정권 견제·심판론’보다 민주당의 ‘이재명 정부 지원, 내란 정당 심판론’에 힘을 실으면서 민주당은 2024년 총선과 2025년 대선에 이어 지방선거까지 3연승하며 입법·행정권력에 이어 지방권력까지 얻게 됐다.)

According to vote counting results as of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th, the ruling Democratic Party was expected to win in Gyeonggi, Incheon, Sejong, Daejeon, North Chungcheong, South Chungcheong, Gwangju (South Jeolla), North Jeolla, Busan, Ulsan, and Jeju. The races in Seoul and South Gyeongsang were neck-and-neck. Compared to the local elections four years ago, held right after former President Yoon Suk Yeol's presidential victory, where the People Power Party won 12 out of 17 metropolitan government headships (Seoul, Incheon, Busan, Daegu, Ulsan, Daejeon, Sejong, North Chungcheong, South Chungcheong, North Gyeongsang, South Gyeongsang, and Gangwon) and the Democratic Party won only five (Gyeonggi, Gwangju, South Jeolla, North Jeolla, and Jeju), this result marks a clear shift in public sentiment. Democratic Party leader and general election committee chairman Jung Cheong-rae said in a phone interview with Park Si-young TV early that morning, "This is a victory for the great people," and "We were able to win thanks to President Lee Jae-myung." (4일 새벽 2시30분까지 개표 결과 여당인 민주당은 경기·인천·세종·대전·충북·충남·전남광주·전북·부산·울산·제주에서 승리가 예상됐다. 서울과 경남은 접전 양상이었다. 윤석열 전 대통령의 대선 승리 직후 치러진 4년 전 지방선거에서 국민의힘이 17개 광역단체장 가운데 서울·인천·부산·대구·울산·대전·세종·충북·충남·경북·경남·강원 등 12곳에서 승리하고, 민주당은 경기·광주·전남·전북·제주 등 5곳에서만 이겼던 결과와 견주면 확연한 민심의 변화가 나타난 것으로 평가된다. 총괄 상임선거대책위원장인 정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 새벽 유튜브 방송 ‘박시영 티브이(TV)’와의 전화 연결에서 “위대한 국민의 승리”라며 “이재명 대통령 덕분에 이길 수 있었다”고 말했다.)

In the Seoul mayoral election, which was a tight race throughout the campaign period, as of 2:30 a.m. (vote count rate 49.9%), Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh was leading with 54.3% of the vote, about 10 percentage points ahead of People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon (43.0%). With only half of the votes counted, both camps are nervously monitoring the results. In the Busan mayoral election, with a high vote count rate of 88.8%, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo (50.6%) is likely to win, edging out People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon (47.8%). In the Gyeonggi Province gubernatorial election (vote count rate 64.5%), Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae (55.2%) secured an early victory with a large margin over People Power Party candidate Yang Hyang-ja (39.3%). In the Ulsan mayoral election (vote count rate 88.5%), Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook (49.3%) was confirmed as the winner. In the North Jeolla Province gubernatorial election (vote count rate 82.7%), Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek (51.5%) opened a nearly 10-percentage-point gap over independent candidate Kim Kwan-young (41.7%), making his victory all but certain. (선거 기간 내내 박빙 접전이 펼쳐졌던 서울시장 선거는 2시30분 현재(개표율 49.9%) 정원오 민주당 후보가 54.3%를 얻어 오세훈 국민의힘 후보(43.0%)를 10%포인트가량 앞섰다. 개표가 절반만 이뤄진 상태라 양쪽 캠프는 긴장 속에 개표 현황을 지켜보고 있다. 개표율이 88.8%로 높은 부산시장 선거에서는 전재수 민주당 후보(50.6%)가 박형준 국민의힘 후보(47.8%)를 따돌리고 당선이 유력하다. 경기지사(개표율 64.5%)의 경우 추미애 더불어민주당 후보(55.2%)가 양향자 국민의힘 후보(39.3%)와 큰 격차를 내며 일찌감치 당선을 확정했다. 울산시장 선거(개표율 88.5%)에선 김상욱 민주당 후보(49.3%)의 당선이 확정됐다. 전북지사(개표율 82.7%)에선 이원택 민주당 후보(51.5%)가 김관영 무소속 후보(41.7%)와 격차를 10%포인트 가까이 벌리며 당선이 확실시됐다.)

The People Power Party won in its traditional strongholds of Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province. In the Daegu mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho won after a close race with Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum. In the North Gyeongsang Province gubernatorial election, People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo was declared the winner. (국민의힘은 전통적 우세 지역인 대구·경북에서 승리했다. 대구시장 선거에서는 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 김부겸 민주당 후보와 접전 끝에 당선됐다. 경북지사 선거에선 이철우 국민의힘 후보가 당선됐다.)

In South Gyeongsang Province, the race between the Democratic Party and the People Power Party remains too close to call at this time. In the South Gyeongsang Province gubernatorial election (vote count rate 68.8%), People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo leads with 50.8%, ahead of Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyeong-soo (49.2%). (경남에서는 민주당과 국민의힘이 이 시각까지 결과를 쉽게 예측할 수 없는 경합을 벌였다. 경남지사 선거(개표율 68.8%)에선 박완수 국민의힘 후보가 50.8%로 김경수 민주당 후보(49.2%)를 앞서는 것으로 집계됐다.)

In the nationwide superintendent of education elections, progressive candidates are projected to lead in 10 out of 16 cities and provinces, including Seoul and Gyeonggi, while conservative candidates are expected to lead in four regions, including Daegu. The National Election Commission reported that the provisional voter turnout for the local elections stood at 61.0% as of 9 p.m. on the 3rd, the highest since the first local elections in 1995 (68.4%). (전국 교육감 선거에서는 16개 시·도 가운데 진보 후보들이 서울과 경기 등 10곳에서 우세하고, 보수 후보는 대구 등 4곳에서 우세할 것으로 예측됐다. 중앙선거관리위원회는 3일 밤 9시 기준 지방선거 잠정 투표율이 61.0%로 집계됐다고 밝혔다. 이는 1995년 치른 첫 지방선거(68.4%) 이후 최고 수치다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Jung Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon in Final Tight Race…Gap Narrows to Under 5% ([속보] 정원오-오세훈 막판 접전…5%p 미만으로 격차 확 줄어)
item.description:
In the vote counting for the Seoul mayoral election—considered the biggest battleground in the June 3 local elections—Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate, has maintained a lead over Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, as of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th. With 49.9% of the votes counted, Jung had 54.3% and Oh had 43.0%. Earlier, a joint exit poll by three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS) had predicted Jung would receive 51.4% and Oh 46.0%. (6·3 지방선거 최대 승부처로 꼽히는 서울시장 선거 개표 결과, 4일 새벽 2시30분 현재 정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 오세훈 국민의힘 후보를 앞서는 흐름이 개표 내내 이어지고 있다. 개표율 49.9% 상황에서 정 후보는 득표율 54.3%, 오 후보는 43.0%였다. 이에 앞서 발표된 방송 3사(KBS·MBC·SBS) 공동 출구조사에선 정 후보가 51.4%, 오 후보가 46.0%를 득표할 것으로 예측됐다.)

When the broadcasters' exit poll results were released, the mood in the two candidate camps diverged sharply. At Jung's campaign office in Jung-gu, central Seoul, a loud cheer of "Wow!" erupted. Staff clapped and celebrated together. However, some officials remained cautious, watching the situation unfold regarding the ballot shortage at certain polling stations in places like Songpa-gu, which had occurred earlier that day. (방송사 출구조사 결과가 공개되자, 두 후보 캠프는 희비가 엇갈렸다. 서울 중구에 마련된 정 후보 캠프 사무실에선 ‘와’ 하는 환호성이 터져나왔다. 관계자들은 서로 박수를 치며 기뻐했다. 다만 일부 관계자들은 이날 벌어진 서울 송파구 등 일부 투표소 투표용지 부족 사태 추이를 지켜보면서 신중한 모습을 보였다.)

A heavy silence fell over Oh's campaign office, located in Daewang Building in Jongno-gu. Soft sighs of "Huh" were heard throughout the camp, and some people wore dazed smiles as if in disbelief. One campaign official was tight-lipped, saying, "We'll have to see the results." A JTBC projection showed Jung at 53.5% and Oh at 42.9%, a difference of 10.6 percentage points. (종로구 대왕빌딩에 위치한 오 후보 사무실에서는 무거운 정적이 흘렀다. 캠프 곳곳에서는 ‘허’ 하는 얕은 한숨이 터져나왔고, 일부는 믿기지 않는다는 듯 허탈한 미소를 짓기도 했다. 한 캠프 관계자는 “(결과는) 까봐야 안다”며 말을 아꼈다. 제이티비시(JTBC) 예측조사에서는 정 후보 53.5%, 오 후보 42.9%로 10.6%포인트 차였다.)

In this joint broadcasters' exit poll, clear differences emerged by age group. Jung's expected vote share was highest among those in their 50s (60.7%) and 40s (53.2%), while Oh's was highest among those in their 70s and older (71.1%) and 60s (60.4%). Among those in their 20s and 30s, Oh had the advantage, but when broken down by gender, support was sharply divided: 48.5% of women under 30 supported Jung, while 75.3% of men under 30 backed Oh. (이번 방송 3사 출구조사에서는 연령대별로 뚜렷한 차이를 보였다. 정 후보의 예상 득표율은 50대(60.7%)와 40대(53.2%)가 가장 높았고, 오 후보는 70대 이상(71.1%)과 60대(60.4%)에서 가장 높았다. 20~30대에서는 오 후보가 우위를 보였지만, 성별로 보면 20대 이하 여성의 48.5%는 정 후보를, 20대 이하 남성의 75.3%는 오 후보를 지지하는 등 지지세가 극명하게 갈렸다.)

Jung, who served three terms as the mayor of Seongdong-gu—the only district among Seoul's 25 autonomous districts where he achieved this—rose to prominence as a leading candidate within the Democratic Party for the Seoul mayoral race after receiving public praise from President Lee Jae-myung last December for "doing a great job." Dubbed the "President Lee's pick," he was selected as the party's Seoul mayoral candidate through internal primaries. Oh, on the other hand, only secured his candidacy on April 18, partly due to internal strife within the People Power Party over "breaking ties with former President Yoon Seok-youl" and conflicts over candidate nominations. Oh advocated for the removal of People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk from the second line and kept his distance during campaign rallies, refusing to appear alongside him. Instead, he focused on capturing centrist votes by scheduling events with former lawmaker Yoo Seung-min, former President Lee Myung-bak, Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok, and lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo. (서울 25개 자치구 가운데 유일하게 성동구에서 3선 구청장을 지낸 정 후보는 지난해 12월 이재명 대통령의 ‘일 잘한다’는 공개 칭찬으로 단박에 민주당 내 유력 서울시장 후보 주자로 올라섰다. 그는 ‘명픽’(이재명 대통령이 선택한) 후보로 불리며 당내 경선에서 서울시장 후보로 선출됐다. 오 후보는 국민의힘 내부의 ‘절윤’(윤석열 전 대통령과의 절연) 내홍과 공천 갈등 탓에 지난 4월18일에야 공천을 확정했다. 오 후보는 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 2선 퇴진을 주장하고, 선거 유세에서도 그와 동행하지 않는 등 거리를 뒀다. 대신 유승민 전 의원과 이명박 전 대통령, 이준석 개혁신당 대표, 안철수 의원 등과 일정을 소화하며 중도 표심을 공략했다.)

Jung initially pulled ahead comfortably, distancing himself from Oh early in the campaign, but the gap narrowed as the two candidates traded attacks over real estate policies. Jung emphasized his commitment to pushing forward redevelopment and reconstruction projects, targeting areas traditionally considered weak in support, such as the Han River belt (including Mapo and Yongsan) and the four southern districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, and Gangdong). (정 후보는 선거 초반 오 후보를 여유 있게 따돌리며 앞서갔으나 이후 두 후보가 부동산 정책으로 공방을 주고받으면서 격차는 좁혀졌다. 정 후보는 재개발·재건축 추진 의지를 부각하면서 지지율 약세 지역으로 분류되는 마포·용산 등 한강벨트, 강남 4구(강남·서초·송파·강동)를 집중 공략했다.)

Oh leveraged his high name recognition and experience in city governance to emphasize stability. He argued the need to check the Lee Jae-myung administration, stating that if elected for a fifth term as mayor, he would attend cabinet meetings to challenge the Lee government's real estate policies. Late in the campaign, "safety issues" emerged as a variable following the missing rebar incident at the GTX Samsung Station and the collapse of the Seosomun overpass. Jung's camp pushed "a safe Seoul" to the forefront, pressuring Oh as the incumbent. Oh countered, saying, "Seoul is a city that prioritizes safety above all," and accused Jung of "turning the tables when he can't present a single achievement related to safety." (오 후보는 높은 인지도와 시정 경험을 앞세워 안정감을 강조했다. 그는 이재명 정부 견제론을 피력하면서 5선 시장에 당선되면 국무회의에 참석해 이재명 정부 부동산 정책에 제동을 걸겠다고 했다. 선거 막바지엔 수도권광역급행철도(GTX) 삼성역 철근 누락 사태와 서소문 고가차도 붕괴 사고로 ‘안전 이슈’가 변수로 등장했다. 정 후보 쪽은 ‘안전한 서울’을 전면에 내세우며 현직인 오 후보를 몰아붙였다. 오 후보는 “서울시는 안전을 가장 중요시하는 도시”라며 “안전과 관련한 단 한가지 업적도 내놓지 못하는 정 후보가 적반하장”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Democrat Kim Sang-wook Certain to Win Ulsan Mayoral Election: "Possible Only Because We Achieved Unification" (민주 김상욱, 울산시장 당선 확실…“단일화 이뤄냈기에 가능했다”)
item.description:
In the Ulsan mayoral election, considered a battleground in the June 3 local elections, Kim Sang-wook of the Democratic Party of Korea is seen as certain to win. (6·3 지방선거 격전지로 꼽혔던 울산시장 선거에서 김상욱 더불어민주당 후보가 당선이 확실시된다.)

As of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th (with 88.51% of votes counted), candidate Kim Sang-wook garnered 49.3% of the vote, ahead of Kim Du-gyeom of the People Power Party (45.2%) and independent candidate Baek Maeng-woo (5.5%). In the joint exit poll by three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS) that day, Kim Sang-wook's vote share was 52.8%, significantly outpacing Kim Du-gyeom's 43.2%. On the night of the 3rd, candidate Kim Sang-wook stated, "This result is not mine alone. It was possible because all comrades from the Progressive Party, the Fatherland Innovation Party, and the broader democratic camp joined hands and achieved unification. I extend my deep gratitude and respect to all comrades who pooled their will beyond party lines." He added, "Even if I am struck a hundred times, if it means citizens become the masters and their interests are protected, I will crawl to take half a step forward." <<> Candidate Kim overcame a critical juncture in unification during the election process to secure victory. With multiple polls showing that combining the support rates of candidates from the Democratic and Progressive camps would surpass that of incumbent mayor Kim Du-gyeom, unification was considered a key variable. <<> Last month, candidate Kim unified with Hwang Myeong-pil of the Fatherland Innovation Party and then with Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party. However, during the unification process with Kim Jong-hoon, Kim Sang-wook declared a halt to the primary, citing "signs of organized interference by certain forces," putting unification at risk of collapse. Kim Jong-hoon accepted the demand for a re-election, and ultimately, Kim Sang-wook was selected as the unified candidate. Subsequently, Kim widened the gap with Kim Du-gyeom. Kim Du-gyeom's failure to unify with Baek Maeng-woo, leading to a split in conservative votes, is also seen as a factor in the victory. <<> Thus, the Democratic Party is likely to win the Ulsan mayoral election for the second time, following 2018 (when Song Cheol-ho won). Candidate Kim Sang-wook, who was elected as a member of the National Assembly for Ulsan's Nam District A under the People Power Party in the 2024 general election, criticized the December 3 insurrection incident and moved to the Democratic Party in May last year. Born in 1980, Kim is expected to become the youngest head of a metropolitan government in this local election. <<> Reporters: Goh Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr, Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (4일 새벽 2시30분 현재(개표율 88.51%) 김상욱 후보는 49.3%의 득표율로 김두겸 국민의힘 후보(45.2%), 박맹우 무소속 후보(5.5%)를 앞섰다. 이날 방송 3사(KBS·MBC·SBS) 공동 출구조사에서도 김상욱 후보의 득표율은 52.8%로, 김두겸 후보(43.2%)를 크게 앞섰다. 김상욱 후보는 3일 밤 “이 결과는 저 한 사람의 것이 아니다. 진보당, 조국혁신당, 범민주 진영의 모든 동지가 함께 손을 맞잡고 단일화를 이뤄냈기에 가능한 일이었다. 당을 넘어 뜻을 모아주신 모든 동지 여러분께 깊은 감사와 존경을 올린다”며 “백 번을 두들겨 맞더라도 시민이 주인 되고 시민의 이익이 지켜진다면 기어서라도 반보를 더 나아가겠다고 말했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Says "Stop the Counting"... Likely Strong Fallout Including Election Lawsuits (국힘 “개표 중단을”…무효소송 등 후폭풍 클 듯)
item.description:
On June 3, the main voting day for the 6·3 local elections, the People Power Party (PPP) strongly protested the ballot paper shortage at some polling stations in Seoul, demanding a halt to vote counting. The Democratic Party of Korea expressed strong regret to the National Election Commission (NEC) but dismissed the PPP's demand to stop counting. With this unprecedented suspension of voting, political and legal repercussions are expected to continue even after the election concludes. (6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일, 서울 일부 투표소에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태에 국민의힘은 개표 중단을 요구하며 강하게 반발했다. 더불어민주당은 중앙선거관리위원회에 강한 유감을 표하면서도 국민의힘의 개표 중단 요구는 일축했다. 사상 초유의 투표 중단 사태가 발생하면서 선거가 끝난 뒤에도 정치적·법적 후폭풍이 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

The PPP is demanding a halt to counting and a re-election. PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk held a briefing on current issues at the party's headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, around 9:30 PM that day, stating, "We must stop the counting immediately, and if necessary, hold a re-election." After the briefing, around 10:30 PM, Jang visited the NEC in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi, to protest and met with NEC Secretary General Huh Chul-hoon, saying, "If counting is not stopped, we will have no choice but to protest and fight using the strongest possible methods." <<> Article 196, Paragraph 1 of the Election Law stipulates: "If elections cannot be held or were not held due to natural disasters or other unavoidable reasons, ... for elections of local council members and heads of local governments, the chairperson of the relevant constituency's election commission must consult with the relevant local government head (including acting heads) to postpone the election." <<> The PPP is focusing on the issue that "the fairness of voting has been compromised." It argues there may have been voters who waited for ballot papers but could not vote due to personal schedules, and those who voted after 6 PM might have been influenced by broadcast exit polls. The Justice Party also issued a statement calling for "the dismissal of NEC Chair Noh Tae-ak." <<> The Democratic Party criticized the PPP's demands as outrageous. Secretary General and General Election Campaign Headquarters head Jo Seung-rae stated, "We will definitely hold the NEC accountable for its poor management," but added, "The PPP's claims for stopping counting and demanding a re-vote are entirely without merit." <<> With the unprecedented voting suspension due to the ballot paper shortage, various legal disputes, including election invalidation lawsuits, are expected to follow. In local elections, to challenge the validity of an election or election, one must first go through a petition process with the relevant election commission. If dissatisfied with the election results, a petition can be filed with the relevant commission within 14 days of the election day, and the commission must decide on acceptance or rejection within 60 days. Parties dissatisfied with this decision can file lawsuits with the Supreme Court (for proportional representation city/provincial councilors and governors) or the relevant High Court (for district city/provincial councilors and mayors/county heads). Kim Jun-woo, a lawyer and former deputy secretary of the Lawyers for a Democratic Society, said, "The judgment on an election invalidation lawsuit can vary depending on the vote gap between the first and second place in the counting results and the total number of voters who could not vote," adding, "For lower-level council elections or proportional representation councilors with small vote differences, it could become a point of contention." <<> Voters who were unable to cast a ballot can file a constitutional complaint with the Constitutional Court, claiming their voting rights were violated, and can also file a damage lawsuit against the state. A lawyer who has handled many election law cases said, "With this unprecedented situation, various lawsuits and legal disputes from candidates and voters are expected to follow." Investigations into the NEC also seem inevitable. Another lawyer, a former public prosecutor, said, "Multiple complaints against the NEC are anticipated. Investigations could be launched on charges such as dereliction of duty." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hwan-bong bonge@hani.co.kr ( 국민의힘은 개표 중단과 함께 재선거를 요구하고 있다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 밤 9시30분께 서울 여의도 중앙당사에서 현안 브리핑을 열어 “지금 당장 개표를 중단해야 하고, 필요에 따라 재선거를 해야 한다”고 말했다. 장 대표는 브리핑 뒤 밤 10시30분께 경기 과천 중앙선관위를 항의 방문한 자리에서 허철훈 선관위 사무총장을 만나 “개표를 중단하지 않으면 가장 강력한 방법으로 항의하고 싸울 수밖에 없다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party's Lee Kwang-jae Elected as Lawmaker for Gyeonggi Hanam Gap (민주 이광재, 경기 하남갑 국회의원 당선)
item.description:
Lee Kwang-jae, the candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, was elected in the June 3 by-election for Gyeonggi Hanam Gap's National Assembly seat. According to the vote tally from the National Election Commission (as of 5:10 a.m. on the 4th), Lee recorded a vote share of 49.67%, defeating People Power Party incumbent Lee Yong (48.13%) by a margin of about 1,300 votes. (이광재 더불어민주당 후보가 6·3 경기 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 당선됐다. 4일 중앙선거관리위원회 개표 현황(새벽 5시10분 현재)을 보면, 이 후보는 49.67%의 득표율을 기록해 이용 국민의힘 의원(48.13%)을 1300여표 차이로 제친 것으로 나타났다.)

Lee served as a three-term lawmaker and Governor of Gangwon Province. Gyeonggi Hanam Gap is the constituency of Democratic Party lawmaker Choo Mi-ae, and the by-election was held after Choo was selected as the party's candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor. Lee, who demonstrated resilience in the conservative-leaning Gyeonggi Seongnam Bundang Gap, was deployed through strategic nomination. (이 후보는 3선 국회의원과 강원지사를 지냈다. 경기 하남갑은 추미애 민주당 의원의 지역구로, 추 의원이 경기지사 후보로 선출되면서 보궐선거를 치르게 됐고, 보수세가 강한 경기 성남 분당갑에서 저력을 보인 이 후보가 전략공천으로 투입됐다.)

item.title: Seoul mayoral election remains a nail-biter with only 8% of ballots left to count… Neck-and-neck race keeps everyone on edge (서울시장 선거, 개표 8% 남았는데도 ‘안갯속’… 피 마르는 초접전)
item.description:
In the June 3 Seoul mayoral election, Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party are locked in a fierce battle as of 7 a.m. today. The early voting day for the local elections saw a shortage of ballot papers in districts like Songpa-gu, Seoul, which delayed voting and counting in the capital, likely affecting the results. As of now, Songpa-gu, Dongjak-gu, and Yeongdeungpo-gu have yet to surpass a 60% count rate. (6·3 서울특별시장 선거에서 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 4일 오전 7시 현재 초접전을 벌이고 있다. 전날 지방선거 본투표 도중 서울 송파구 등에서 ‘투표 용지 부족 사태’가 발생해 서울지역 투·개표가 늦어지고 있는 것도 영향을 끼친 것으로 보인다. 송파구와 동작구, 영등포구는 이 시각까지도 개표율이 60%대를 넘지 못하고 있다. )

According to the National Election Commission's vote tally, with 92.30% of the votes counted, Jung and Oh are respectively at 48.84% and 48.44%, making for a nail-biting contest with no clear winner in sight. After Jung initially held a lead in the counting, Oh launched a fierce comeback around 4 a.m. today. The vote gap has narrowed to 20,000 to 30,000 votes. By 7 a.m., the margin had shrunk to about 19,000 votes. (중앙선거관리위원회 개표 상황을 보면, 개표율이 92.30%인 상황에서 정 후보와 오 후보는 각각 48.84%, 48.44%를 기록하며 한치 앞도 보이지 않는 피 마르는 승부를 하고 있다. 전날 개표에서 대체로 정 후보가 우세를 보인 가운데, 이날 새벽 4시께 오 후보가 맹추격을 시작했다. 두 후보의 득표는 2만~3만여표로 차이로 좁혀진 상황이다. 오전 7시 기준으로는 격차가 1만9천여표까지 줄었다. )

Earlier, in the joint exit poll of three broadcasters (KBS, MBC, SBS) released at 6 p.m. on election day for the June 3 local elections, Jung was projected to win 51.4% of the vote, leading Oh (46%) by 5.4 percentage points. (앞서, 전날 오후 6시 발표된 6·3 지방선거 방송 3사(KBS·MBC·SBS) 공동 출구조사에서 정 후보가 51.4%를 득표해 오 후보(46%)를 5.4%포인트 앞설 것으로 예측됐다.)

JTBC's forecast showed Jung at 53.5% and Oh at 42.9%. (제이티비시(JTBC) 예측조사에서는 정 후보 53.5%, 오 후보로 42.9%로 나타났다.)

item.title: Kim Min-soo of People Power Party, Hand in Hand with Jeon Han-gil, Says “Inadequate Election Is Fraud” (전한길 손 잡은 국힘 김민수 “부실선거 강요, 부정선거”)
item.description:
Amid strong backlash from the People Power Party, which demanded a halt to vote counting following a ballot shortage at some polling stations in Seoul on the 3rd, the main voting day for the June 3 local elections, Kim Min-soo, a Supreme Council member of the People Power Party, staged a scene where he held hands with far-right YouTuber Jeon Han-gil, who promotes election fraud conspiracy theories. (6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 서울 일부 투표소에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태에 국민의힘이 개표 중단을 요구하며 강하게 반발하는 가운데, 김민수 국민의힘 최고위원이 부정선거 음모론을 주장하는 극우 유튜버 전한길씨와 손을 붙잡는 모습을 연출했다.)

Supreme Council member Kim appeared on stage at a protest rally against the National Election Commission (NEC) in front of the commission’s headquarters in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province, early on the 4th. Kim said, “I went around the NEC today, trying to coax them and shouting at them. (But) they say that a vote can’t be stopped just because of poor management. I said that if they take a shoddy election for granted, that’s an election fraud.” (김 최고위원은 4일 새벽 경기 과천시 중앙선거관리위원회 앞에서 열린 선관위 항의 집회 무대에 올랐다. 김 최고위원은 “오늘 선관위를 이곳저곳 돌면서 얼러도 보고 소리도 쳐봤다. (그런데) 관리 부실 정도로는 선거를 멈출 수가 없다고 한다”며 “부실 선거가 당연하다면 그것은 부정선거라고 이야기했다”고 말했다.)

Kim added, “If they admit the inadequacy and can stop the election, fine, but if they can force and coerce a shoddy election and strip the people of their suffrage, this country is no longer the liberal democratic Republic of Korea.” After Kim’s remarks, when one rally participant shouted, “It’s intentional,” Kim replied, “That’s right. It’s intentional.” (이어 김 최고위원은 “부실을 인정하고 선거를 멈출 수 있다면 몰라도 부실선거를 강요, 강제하고 국민들의 참정권을 뺏을 수 있다면 그 나라는 자유민주주의 대한민국이 아니”라고 덧붙였다. 김 최고위원의 발언 이후 집회 참석자 가운데 한 명이 “의도된 것입니다”라고 외치자 김 최고위원은 “맞다. 의도된 것”이라고 답하기도 했다.)

Kim mentioned People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, saying, “Even if the People Power Party can’t say everything using institutional language, there are people who fought with the same thoughts as you, with the determination to protect the free Republic of Korea.” (김 최고위원은 “국민의힘에도 제도권의 언어로 다 말할 순 없어도 여러분과 같은 생각으로, 자유대한민국을 지키겠다는 마음으로 싸웠던 사람들이 있다”며 장동혁 국민의힘 대표를 언급했다.)

After finishing his speech, Kim held hands with Jeon and former 707th Special Mission Group commander Kim Hyun-tae of the Army Special Warfare Command, who ran as an independent in the Incheon Gyeyang by-election for the National Assembly, and greeted the rally participants. (발언을 끝낸 김 최고위원은 전씨와 인천 계양을 국회의원 보궐선거에 무소속으로 출마한 김현태 전 육군 특수전사령부 707특수임무단장 등과 함께 손을 붙잡고 집회 참가자들을 향해 인사했다.)

Earlier, on the 3rd, the main voting day for the June 3 local elections, an unprecedented suspension of voting occurred due to a ballot shortage. Protest rallies have been ongoing at the Jamsil 7-dong No. 2 polling station in Seoul, where voting was extended until 10 p.m., and in front of the NEC in Gwacheon. Jeon, attending the rally in front of the NEC in Gwacheon, claimed, “June 3, 2026, will be recorded as the second April 19 Revolution and the day when all citizens united to protect the sovereignty of the free Republic of Korea, realizing a second democracy.” Hundreds of members of conservative groups that promote election fraud conspiracy theories gathered there, chanting “Fundamentally invalid” and “Election fraud.” (앞서 6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 투표용지 부족으로 초유의 투표 중단 사태가 벌어지자 밤 10시까지 투표 연장이 이뤄졌던 서울 잠실7동 제2투표소와 과천 선관위 앞에서는 항의 시위가 이어지고 있다. 전씨는 과천 선관위 앞 집회에 참석해 “2026년 6월3일은 제2의 4·19 혁명이자 자유 대한민국의 주권을 수호하기 위한 모든 국민들이 하나로 뭉쳐서 제2의 민주주의를 실현한 날로 기록될 것”이라고 주장했다. 이곳에는 부정선거 음모론을 주장하는 보수단체 회원 등 수백명이 모여 “원천 무효”, “부정선거” 등을 외쳤다.)

At the rally in front of the Jamsil 7-dong No. 2 polling station, People Power Party politicians, including Rep. Kim Eun-hye, joined in, demanding “Election invalid” and “Stop the count.” Rep. Kim visited the Jamsil No. 2 polling station early that morning and said, “This election is invalid. It’s invalid because they contaminated the election, contaminated democracy and the rule of law.” Hundreds of people have gathered at the polling station, installed at a senior center in Woosung Apartment in Songpa-gu, Seoul, chanting about election fraud, preventing the ballot boxes from being taken out. (잠실7동 제2투표소 앞 집회에는 김은혜 의원 등 국민의힘 정치인들이 합류해 “선거 무효”와 “개표 중단”을 주장했다. 김 의원은 이날 새벽 잠실 제2투표소를 찾아 “이번 선거는 무효”라며 “선거를 오염시켰기 때문에, 민주주의와 법치를 오염시켰기 때문에 무효”라고 말했다. 서울 송파구 우성아파트 경로당에 설치된 해당 투표소에는 수백명이 몰려 부정선거 등을 외치고 있어 투표함 반출이 이뤄지지 못하고 있다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Inspects New Nuclear Material Production Plant, Emphasizes "Exponential Strengthening of Nuclear Force" (김정은, 새 핵물질 생산공장 시찰…“핵무력 기하급수적 강화” 강조)
item.description:
North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un inspected a new nuclear material production plant, presumed to be a uranium enrichment facility, underscoring his commitment to bolstering the nuclear force. <<> The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 4th that Kim visited the newly operational nuclear material production plant the previous day, accompanied by leading officials from the Central Committee's Munitions Industry Department and the Nuclear Weapons Institute. The agency did not disclose the plant's specific location or production capacity. While three known locations for North Korea's uranium enrichment facilities include Yongbyon in North Pyongan Province, Kangseon in Nampo City, and Kusong in North Pyongan Province, there is a possibility that this newly built high-enriched uranium facility in a "fourth region" has been unveiled. <<> Kim inspected the new production process, which incorporates more sophisticated technology than before, reviewing operational targets and production plans. <<> Kim praised the progress, stating that "under the direct guidance of the 8th Central Committee, over the past five years of the nuclear force strengthening course, weapons-grade nuclear material production capacity has reached a level exceeding twice that of the past," and noted that the decisions adopted at major plenary meetings are being accurately implemented. <<> He further announced, "The 9th Party Congress has decided on a new five-year plan for nuclear force strengthening to continuously enhance the country's nuclear war deterrence," adding that "a strategic decision was adopted to further expand nuclear material production capacity and accordingly continue to increase the number of nuclear weapons." Kim also emphasized the "special nature of our revolution, which requires a long-term confrontation with the most brutal adversaries," stressing that nuclear weapons are "the fundamental guarantee that reliably protects the country's sovereignty, interests, and development rights." <<> He reiterated the stance of thoroughly exercising the status of a nuclear state, saying, "The urgency and responsibility of the historic mission to qualitatively, continuously, and acceleratively expand the nuclear war deterrence, a powerful safety device, are further rising." <<> KCNA also reported that an important consultative meeting on nuclear force strengthening was held that day. Kim, delivering key conclusions with explicit action guidelines, stated, "Today, we have updated important numbers in nuclear activities," adding that "tactical and strategic demand aspects have been fully considered in building nuclear deterrence." He described it as "a historic event marking a transformative milestone for advancing nuclear capabilities," adding, "We have finalized the sequence and guarantees for implementing the vast future plan to exponentially strengthen the national nuclear force." <<> According to photos released by North Korean media, the plant was densely lined with cylindrical centrifuges, devices necessary for uranium enrichment. Additionally, materials presumed to contain key plans for nuclear force strengthening on the conference table where Kim sat, along with some attendees, were blurred beyond recognition. <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 우라늄 농축 시설로 보이는 새로운 핵물질 생산공장을 시찰하며 핵 무력 강화 의지를 강조했다.)

item.title: Kim Byung-wook, Former Political Affairs Secretary, Loses Seongnam Mayoral Race (정무비서관 출신 김병욱, 성남시장 선거에서 고배)
item.description:
Kim Byung-wook, a former presidential secretary for political affairs and a member of the original "pro-Lee Jae-myung" faction group known as the "Group of Seven," failed to reclaim the Seongnam mayoral seat. Given that President Lee Jae-myung previously served as Seongnam's mayor, the ruling camp is taking this as a disappointing outcome. (원조 친이재명계(친명) 모임인 7인회 멤버였던 김병욱 전 청와대 정무비서관이 성남시장을 탈환하는 데 실패했다. 이재명 대통령이 과거 성남시장을 지냈다는 점에서 특히 여권은 아쉬운 결과로 받아들이는 분위기다.)

With 99.91% of the vote counted in the Seongnam mayoral election on the 4th, Democratic Party candidate Kim Byung-wook (48.7%) lost to People Power Party candidate Shin Sang-jin (50.3%) by a margin of 1.6 percentage points. Progressive Party candidate Jang Ji-hwa secured 1% of the vote. ( 4일 성남시장 선거의 개표율이 99.91%인 가운데, 김병욱 더불어민주당 후보(48.7%)는 신상진 국민의힘 후보(50.3%)에 1.6%포인트 차이로 패했다. 장지화 진보당 후보는 1%를 득표했다. )

Candidate Kim, a member of the original pro-Lee faction "Group of Seven," previously served as a lawmaker for Seongnam's Bundang-gu district in the 20th and 21st National Assemblies. Under the Lee Jae-myung administration, he served as a presidential secretary for political affairs. ( 김 후보는 원조 친명 모임 7인회 출신으로 20~21대 성남 분당을 국회의원을 지냈다. 이재명 정부 들어 청와대 정무비서관을 지냈다. )

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Wins Fifth Term as Seoul Mayor… Late Comeback Victory Over Jung Won-oh (오세훈, 서울시장 5선 성공…정원오에 막판 역전승)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, was elected in the June 3 local elections for Seoul mayor, becoming the first person to achieve a fifth term in that office. As of 9:30 a.m. on the 4th, with 97.70% of the votes counted, Oh secured 48.94% of the vote, overtaking Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea, who received 48.34%. Jung conceded defeat around 9:30 a.m. (오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에 당선되면서 최초 5선 서울시장 고지에 올랐다. 오 후보는 4일 오전 9시30분 개표 상황(개표율 97.70%)에서 48.94%의 득표율로 48.34%를 그친 정원오 더불어민주당 후보에 역전승을 거뒀다. 정 후보는 오전 9시30분께 승복 선언을 했다.)

Oh served his first and second terms as Seoul mayor from 2006 to 2011, followed by his third and fourth terms starting in 2021. During this election period, he distanced himself from the People Power Party leadership under Jang Dong-hyuk and deployed a strategy leveraging his incumbency advantage and high recognition. As a non-mainstream faction member, Oh is expected to serve as a focal point for conservative realignment while also strengthening his position as a leading conservative presidential candidate. (오 후보는 2006~20011년 서울시장 초·재선을, 지난 2021년부터 3·4선을 지냈다. 이번 선거 기간 장동혁 국민의힘 지도부와 거리를 두고, 자신이 지닌 현역 시장 프리미엄과 높은 인지도를 앞세우는 전략을 폈다. 비당권파인 오 후보는 앞으로 보수 재편의 구심점으로 역할하는 한편, 보수 유력 대선 주자로서의 발판도 다지게 됐다.)

Oh's victory over Jung in a fiercely contested race is seen as reflecting voter sentiment to check the Lee Jae-myung administration and concerns over real estate issues among Seoul residents. (오 후보가 치열한 접전 양상 속에 정 후보를 누른 것은 이재명 정부 견제 심리와 서울 시민들의 부동산 민심 등이 반영된 결과로 풀이된다.)

item.title: "Fuel for Election Fraud Forces"…Progressive and Justice Party Call for Resignation of Election Commission Chair (“부정선거 세력에 빌미”…진보·정의당, 선관위원장 사퇴 촉구)
item.description:
On the day of the main vote for the June 3 local elections, when an unprecedented incident of ballot shortages occurred at some polling stations in Seoul on the 3rd, the Progressive Party and the Justice Party urged the resignation of Noh Tae-ak, chair of the National Election Commission (NEC), citing that this provided a pretext for those advocating "election fraud conspiracy theories." (6·3 지방선거 본투표일인 3일 서울 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족이라는 초유의 사태가 발생하자 진보당과 정의당은 ‘부정선거 음모론’을 주장하는 이들에게 빌미를 제공했다며 노태악 중앙선거관리위원회(선관위) 위원장의 사퇴를 촉구했다.)

The Progressive Party, in a briefing by Deputy Spokesperson Park Tae-woo on the 4th, pointed out, "What kind of times are these? It's a sensitive moment where forces plotting 'election fraud conspiracy theories' at every opportunity are wide-eyed and ready to shake the election results," adding, "In such a grave situation, the NEC, which oversees national election affairs, has instead sparked controversy with absurd mismanagement." (진보당은 4일 박태우 부대변인 브리핑에서 “지금이 어느 때냐. 틈만 나면 ‘부정선거 음모론’을 획책하며 선거 결과를 흔들려는 세력이 시퍼렇게 눈을 뜨고 있는 예민한 시국”이라며 “이러한 엄중한 상황에서 국가 선거 사무를 총괄하는 선관위가 도리어 황당한 부실 관리로 논란의 불씨를 지폈다”고 짚었다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Park said, "How can we tell the public to trust the fairness of elections with this?" and "We strongly denounce the NEC's behavior, which has sent the trust in elections, the foundation of democracy, plummeting to rock bottom." (박 부대변인은 “이래서야 어떻게 국민에게 선거의 공정성을 믿으라 말할 수 있겠냐”며 “민주주의의 근간인 선거 신뢰도를 밑바닥까지 추락시킨 선관위의 행태를 강력히 규탄한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "This incident has become a perfect excuse for the People Power Party and far-right forces," adding, "As if they were waiting, the People Power Party has gone all out, talking about 'stopping the vote counting' and 'filing election invalidation lawsuits,' inciting election rejection, while far-right forces have even staged surprise late-night protests, spreading election fraud conspiracy theories." (이어 “이번 사태는 국민의힘과 극우 세력에게 훌륭한 핑곗거리가 됐다”며 “국민의힘은 기다렸다는 듯 총력을 다해 ‘개표 중단’과 ‘선거무효 소송’을 운운하며 선거 불복 선동에 나섰고, 극우 세력들은 심야 기습 시위까지 벌이며 부정선거 음모론을 확산시키고 있다”고 했다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Park emphasized, "The one who provided these forces with a decisive pretext was none other than the NEC," and demanded, "We call for the immediate resignation of Noh Tae-ak, the NEC chair, and the entire leadership who allowed this situation to happen." (박 부대변인은 “이들에게 결정적 빌미를 제공한 것은 다름 아닌 선관위”라며 “사태를 이 지경으로 만든 노태악 선관위원장을 비롯한 지도부 전원의 즉각적인 사퇴를 요구한다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Justice Party also strongly criticized the NEC. (정의당도 선관위를 강하게 비판했다.)

In a statement on the 3rd, the Justice Party said, "With this incident, the nearly dead People Power Party has rallied and is demanding a postponement of the election," and "The NEC has not only failed to properly ensure the fairness of the election but has provided the worst possible pretext to election fraud conspiracy theorists, including Hwang Kyo-ahn." (정의당은 3일 성명에서 “이번 사태로 다 죽어가던 국민의힘이 결집해 선거 연기를 요구하고 있다”며 “선관위는 선거의 공정성을 제대로 세우기는커녕 황교안을 비롯한 부정선거 음모론자들에게 최악의 빌미를 제공했다”고 했다.)

The Justice Party expressed, "We deeply regret that such an incident occurred at a critical time when we should be uprooting the insurrection forces and completely eliminating conspiracy theorists," and urged, "Noh Tae-ak, the NEC chair, should resign immediately." (정의당은 “내란 세력의 뿌리를 뽑고 음모론자들을 완전히 퇴출시켜야 할 중요한 시점에 이런 사태가 벌어진 것에 매우 큰 유감을 표한다”며 “노태악 선관위원장은 즉각 사퇴하라”고 촉구했다.)

The Justice Party added, addressing the People Power Party, "The People Power Party, including Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, who is spreading conspiracy theories again using this incident as a pretext, should exercise restraint," and "The public is clearly watching the true colors of an incompetent party that has nothing to rely on but election fraud conspiracy theories." (정의당은 국민의힘을 향해 “이번 사태를 빌미 삼아 다시 음모론을 확산하고 있는 장동혁 대표를 비롯한 국민의힘은 자중하라”며 “기댈 곳이 부정선거 음모론뿐인 무능한 정당의 민낯을 국민들은 똑똑히 지켜보고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Won-oh Jeong Concedes Defeat: “Everything is My Fault… I Humbly Accept the Citizens’ Choice” (정원오 패배 승복 “모든 것이 제 탓…시민 선택 겸허히 받들 것”)
item.description:
Won-oh Jeong, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor who lost in the June 3 local elections, declared his concession, stating, “I will solemnly and humbly accept the choice of the citizens,” and “I was lacking. Everything is my fault.” (6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거에서 낙선한 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 “시민 여러분의 선택을 무겁고 겸허히 받들겠다”며 “제가 부족했다. 모든 것이 제 탓이다”라고 승복을 선언했다.)

At around 9:30 AM on the 4th, at his election office on Sejong-daero in Jung-gu, Seoul, Candidate Jeong said, “I failed to get closer and listen more deeply,” and “I failed to win broader hearts.” He added, “To the citizens who trusted and stood by me, the campaign staff, volunteers, camp associates, and fellow party members, I am sorry for not living up to your expectations,” while also expressing, “I extend my congratulations to the elected candidate, Se-hoon Oh.” (정 후보는 4일 오전 9시30분께 서울 중구 세종대로에 있는 선거 사무소에서 “더 가까이 다가가지 못했고, 더 깊이 듣지 못했다”면서 “더 넓게 마음을 얻지 못했다”라고 했다. 이어 “저를 믿고 함께해 주신 시민 여러분, 선거 운동원과 자원봉사자, 또 캠프 관계자, 당원 동지 여러분께 기대에 보답하지 못해 송구하다”면서도 “당선된 오세훈 후보께 축하의 말씀을 전한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Candidate Jeong lost to Se-hoon Oh of the People Power Party, who received 48.94% of the vote compared to Jeong’s 48.34% in the ballot counting as of 9:30 AM that day (with 97.70% of ballots counted). (정 후보는 이날 오전 9시30분 개표 상황(개표율 97.70%)에서 48.34%를 득표해 48.94%를 득표한 오세훈 국민의힘 후보에게 패했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Citizens Left a Safety Valve for Democracy... The Ballot Paper Problem Cannot Be Buried" (오세훈 “시민이 민주주의 안전판 남겼다…투표지 문제, 묻어둘 순 없어”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, expressed his election victory sentiment on the 4th, saying, "It is a victory of common sense," and "The citizens have left Seoul as the last safety valve of democracy so that the Republic of Korea does not tilt completely to one side." However, regarding the shortage of ballot papers that occurred in Seoul's Songpa District and elsewhere, he stated, "Just because the citizens created a great victory doesn't mean we can bury this serious defect that occurred in the process as if nothing happened." <<> Oh, wearing a suit and a red tie, appeared at his campaign office in Jongno-gu, Seoul, around 9:50 a.m. that day and said, "Seoul's future has brightened. A bright green light has also been turned on for the quality of life of Seoul citizens," adding, "I do not consider this election result to be a personal victory for me, Oh Se-hoon." <<> Oh said, "The citizens have firmly re-established the great principle of checks and balances," and "The citizens have shown that no power can reign above the law and no administration can stand above the people. I extend my deep respect and gratitude to the citizens who have preserved the balance of democracy in the name of Seoul." <<> Regarding the shortage of ballot papers, Oh stated, "The process is as important as the result," and "There was confusion at polling places throughout Seoul. As a candidate, I express deep regret over the infringement on the citizens' right to vote, which is the most basic and sacred right of democracy." He added, "We must thoroughly investigate what the problem was, and there must be corresponding strict accountability and fundamental improvements." <<> Oh said, "I will surely repay you with greater change and better results than the past five years," and "I will humbly embrace the voices that did not support me as a whip to work harder." He added, "Now it's time to get back to work," and "I will immediately return to city administration and solve the problems that weigh down the citizens' lives one by one." Regarding the collapse of the Seosomun Elevated Road in Seoul during the election period, he stated, "As soon as I return to work, I will launch a high-intensity special safety inspection of all aging infrastructure and construction sites in Seoul." <<> At the same time, with 97.7% of the vote counting completed in the Seoul mayoral election, Oh received 2,501,865 votes (48.9%), leading Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate who received 2,471,506 votes (48.3%), by 33,359 votes. With most of the vote counting completed in 25 autonomous districts in Seoul, the vote counting rate in Songpa District, where the ballot paper shortage occurred, is at 75.6%, the slowest. Songpa District has a relatively strong support base for the People Power Party, and analysts say Oh has solidified his lead. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 4일 “상식의 승리”라며 “시민 여러분께서 대한민국이 한쪽으로 완전히 기울지 않도록 서울을 민주주의의 마지막 안전판을 남겼다”고 당선 소감을 밝혔다. 다만 오 후보는 서울 송파구 등에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태에 대해선 “시민들이 위대한 승리를 만들어 줬다고해서 그 과정에서 발생한 이 중대한 결함까지 아무 일 없었던 것처럼 묻어둘 수 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "It Hurts We Couldn't Reclaim Seoul... Grateful to the People Who Brought a Nationwide Victory" (정청래 “서울 탈환 못해 아프다…전국적 승리 안긴 국민께 감사”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, expressed regarding the results of the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections, "I deeply thank the people who gave the Democratic Party a great victory nationwide," while also stating, "It hurts that we couldn't reclaim Seoul." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐 선거 결과에 대해 “전국적으로 민주당에 큰 승리를 안겨주신 국민 여러분께 깊이 감사드린다”면서도 “서울을 탈환하지 못해 아프다”라고 밝혔다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on the morning of the 4th, Leader Jung said, "With this victory in the June 3 local elections, the Lee Jae-myung administration can now carry out stable state affairs. We were able to win thanks to President Lee Jae-myung." Leader Jung maintained a stern expression throughout the press conference. (정 대표는 4일 오전 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “이번 6·3 지방선거 승리로 이재명 정부가 안정적인 국정 운영을 할 수 있게 됐다. 이재명 대통령 덕분에 승리할 수 있었다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 기자회견 내내 굳은 표정을 유지했다.)

Furthermore, Leader Jung said, "I offer my deepest condolences to the candidates who gave their all but unfortunately lost," mentioning candidate Oh Joong-ki, who ran for Gyeongsangbuk-do governor, and candidate Kim Boo-kyum, who ran for Daegu mayor. Following this, Leader Jung congratulated the winners of 12 metropolitan and provincial government head positions, including Gyeonggi Province Governor-elect Choo Mi-ae, by calling out their names. "There were also many strong performances in the elections for basic local government heads, such as the mayor of Gangneung City in Gangwon Province, where the Democratic Party had never won before," he said. (또 정 대표는 “혼신을 다했지만, 아쉽게 패배하신 후보자들께 깊은 위로의 마음을 전한다”라며 경북도지사에 도전했던 오중기 후보와 대구시장에 도전했던 김부겸 후보를 거론했다. 이어 정 대표는 추미애 경기도지사 당선자 등 12곳 광역자치단체장 당선자를 호명하며 축하를 전했다. 정 대표는 “한 번도 (민주당이) 당선되지 못했던 강원도 강릉시장 등 기초단체장 선거에서도 많은 선전이 있었다”고 했다.)

Leader Jung stated, "I am especially deeply grateful to the members of the Progressive Party for rallying the momentum for victory through the unification of the Ulsan mayoral candidate," and added, "We will seriously consider and study future methods of alliance with other parties, including the introduction of a runoff voting system." (정 대표는 “특히 울산시장 후보 단일화를 통해 승리의 기세를 모아주신 진보당 당원 여러분들께도 깊이 감사드린다”라며 “(결선투표제 도입 등) 다른 당과의 연대 방법에 대해서도 앞으로 깊이 고민, 연구하도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)
